{{Top|leg}}
'''Key'lya''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Commenting on the entry for the [[Barkhesh/Legends|Barkhesh]] [[Insect Culture]], Key'lya revealed that they would replace the insect repellant with something more practical, such as a paralyzing agent or [[stun gas]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
